decision_cruda.rationale: LH-01 is down at TJ-C512-10 (radio and CMMS agree). The likely repair is 13:20, so the stope would sit idle with 140 t at 13.4 g/t, about 60 oz. LH-08 comes from the infrastructure heading, which is the cheapest source at 0.5 oz/h. Travel is 0.69 h. An LH410 loads 29.1 t/h there, so the 140 t takes about 5 h including lunch. The development cost is about 2.5 oz. Central trucks (91 t/h) are not limiting against the 63 t/h inflow. Other loaders come from producing stopes or higher-value development, so I left them alone.

Keep LH-08 at C512-10 (123 t at 13.4 g/t, about 53 oz, finishes in about 4.2 h; LH-01 is not back until 12:20 at the earliest). LH-06 is down at N574-15 until 15:00-17:00, which strands 147 t at 9.4 g/t (about 44 oz). Lend LH-09 from DS-N522-02, 0.34 h away. It loads 30 t/h, so about 4.9 h clears the stope. Development cost is 2 oz/h, so about 11 oz over the round trip. Net is about +32 oz. Norte inflow rises to about 63 t/h against 66 t/h truck capacity, so trucks are not limiting. No reserve activation because no stope is stopped. LH-02 and the Este and Central loaders keep their own stopes.
